title: Oath: Chronicles of Empire and Exile
subtitle: Generational Fantasy Strategy Legacy Campaign
tagline: Forge the history of an entire fantasy realm across generations where each victory reshapes the cards and world.
loreSummary: In Oath, there are no pre-scripted narratives or plastic miniature rails. One player reigns as the imperial Chancellor while others scheme as Citizens or banished Exiles. The decisions made in each game dictate the map, cards, and victory conditions for the generations that follow.
keyFeatures: Groundbreaking generational legacy design by Cole Wehrle with emergent narrative
Dynamic World Deck where cards are added, archived, or purged based on each game's victor
Fluid political roles: swear fealty as a Citizen or wage rebellious war as an Exile
Stunning storybook visual artistry illustrated by Kyle Ferrin

oath_grand_dynasty.name: The Grand Chronicle Dynasty (12 Chronicle Games)
oath_grand_dynasty.description: An epic generational legacy spanning 12 games of changing rulers, evolving religions, and dynastic upheavals.

oath_reign_of_chancellors.name: The First Chancellor's Reign (4 Chronicle Games)
oath_reign_of_chancellors.description: An introductory generational arc establishing the realm's core order and testing the initial succession.

oath_immortal_empire.name: Century of Strife (18 Chronicle Games)
oath_immortal_empire.description: A sweeping, centuries-long saga tracking the rise and complete collapse of multiple imperial bloodlines.
